chapters.summary: Council staff call the Committee on Finance vote to order, ask attendees to place electronic devices on vibrate, and tell Chair Lee the committee is ready to begin.
chapters.title: Council staff open the Finance Committee vote and ask devices be silenced

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Welcome to today's New York City Council vote for the Committee on Finance.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: At this time, please place all electronic devices to vibrate.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Chair Lee, we are ready to begin.

chapters.summary: Council Member Linda Lee convenes the meeting as Chair of the Committee on Finance and introduces herself to the room.
chapters.title: Chair Linda Lee convenes the Committee on Finance

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: Good morning, Councilmember Linda Lee, Chair of the Committee on Finance.

chapters.summary: Chair Lee reads the roster of committee members present, naming Aldebol, Narcisse, Marte, Morano, Feliz, Aviles, Brooks-Powers, Hudson, Restler, Sanchez, Williams, Wong and Maloney, and notes Gennaro is on Zoom.
chapters.title: Chair Lee recognizes attending Finance Committee members

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: I would like to recognize my fellow committee members.

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: We have Councilmembers Aldabal, Narcisse, Marte, Marano, Feliz, Aviles, Brooks-Powers, Hudson, Ressler, Jay Sanchez, Williams, Wong, and Maloney.

chapters.summary: Chair Lee states the committee will consider and vote on two pre-considered resolutions approving real property tax exemptions under Article 11 of the Private Housing Finance Law.
chapters.title: Lee outlines two Article 11 tax exemption resolutions on the agenda

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: At today's hearing, the committee will consider and vote on the following items.

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: Two pre-considered resolutions approving real property tax exemptions under Article 11 of the private housing law for the following projects.

chapters.summary: Chair Lee identifies the two projects: Fordham-Bedford Cluster Phase 1 in the districts of Council Members Dinowitz and Feliz, and Gowanus Green A in Council Member Hanif's district.
chapters.title: Lee names Fordham-Bedford Cluster Phase 1 and Gowanus Green A projects

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: Fordham-Bedford Cluster Phase 1 in the districts of Council Members Dinowitz and Feliz, and Gowanus Green A in Council Member Hanif's district.

chapters.summary: Chair Lee invites members to make statements or comments on either resolution; no member offers remarks.
chapters.title: Lee asks for member statements; none offered

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: Does anyone have any statements or comments they'd like to make?

chapters.summary: With no discussion, Chair Lee asks the committee clerk to call the roll on the two items.
chapters.title: Lee directs the clerk to call the roll

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: Okay, thank you, and now I will ask the clerk to call the roll.

chapters.summary: Committee Clerk Ben Jacobs identifies himself and announces a roll call vote on the two pre-considered items.
chapters.title: Clerk Ben Jacobs announces roll call on the two pre-considered items

utterances.speaker: Ben Jacobs
utterances.text: Ben Jacobs, Committee Clerk, Committee on Finance.

utterances.speaker: Ben Jacobs
utterances.text: Roll call vote on the two pre-considered items.

chapters.summary: Clerk Jacobs calls each member in turn; Chair Lee, Gennaro, Brooks-Powers, Feliz, Aviles, Marte, Narcisse, Maloney, Sanchez, Wong and Morano each vote aye, with Feliz adding congratulations to everyone.
chapters.title: Members vote aye in roll call on both tax exemption items

chapters.summary: Clerk Jacobs reports the tally: 15 in the affirmative, none in the negative, and no abstentions on the two resolutions.
chapters.title: Roll call result announced: 15-0, no abstentions

utterances.speaker: Ben Jacobs
utterances.text: Okay, that's a vote of 15 in the affirmative, none in the negative, with no abstentions.

chapters.summary: Chair Lee initially says the vote will be held open for Majority Leader Abreu, who had not yet voted.
chapters.title: Lee holds the vote open for Majority Leader Abreu

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: Okay, and we're holding it open for Majority Leader Breu.

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: I think we can actually close the vote.

chapters.summary: Chair Lee decides to close the vote without waiting further, thanks the members, and adjourns the committee's business.
chapters.title: Lee closes the vote and thanks members

utterances.speaker: Linda Lee
utterances.text: And with that, we are going to close the vote.

summary: The Committee on Finance, chaired by Council Member Linda Lee, met to consider and vote on two pre-considered resolutions granting Article 11 real property tax exemptions.
The projects were Fordham-Bedford Cluster Phase 1 in the Bronx (Districts 11 and 15) and Gowanus Green A in Brooklyn (District 39).
No members offered statements; the roll call passed 15-0 with no abstentions, and Chair Lee closed the vote after briefly holding it open for Majority Leader Abreu.
title: Committee on Finance
topic: Fordham Bedford Cluster Phase 1: Block 3304, Lot 156; Block 3324, Lot 99, Bronx, Community District 7, Council Districts 11 and 15
